summary: Materialized/read complete primary Greek An.Post.I.2–3 from the pinned Bekker1837 First1KGreek edition. Six prose readings isolate demonstrative-premise norms, the opponents' shared demonstrativism, the conditional-only regress objection, Aristotle's positive immediate-knowledge reply and qualified circularity arguments. Rejected immediate=arbitrary dogma, actual traversal=dispositional availability, all generated warrant=all knowledge, finite necessary branch=global finite proof and epistemic no-regress=causal impossibility. Existing RegressSchema.justificationTransfer and CrossDomainBoundary already supply the exact structural controls; no new proof is justified. Independent entitlement, termination/access and applicability to strongest infinitist/holistic rivals remain open. Full source/argument/reuse/premise comparison in docs/notes/aristotelian-first-principles-and-regress.md. Root premise change none.
